name: remus
description: Checks Claude Code's tool calls against your Remus policy before they run: deny, hold for a reviewer, or let Claude Code's normal permission flow continue.

agent_key.title: Remus agent key
agent_key.description: An agent key from the Remus dashboard (Agents and keys). Starts with remus_agent_. If left empty, the REMUS_AGENT_KEY environment variable is used.

api_url.title: Remus API URL
api_url.description: Leave empty for https://api.remus.new-odyssey.com. Must be https, except for localhost.

on_allow.title: When Remus allows a call
on_allow.description: prompt (default): Claude Code's normal permission flow still applies. approve: skip Claude Code's permission prompt for calls Remus allows.

review_wait_seconds.title: Seconds to wait for a reviewer
review_wait_seconds.description: How long a call that Remus holds for approval waits for a reviewer before the timeout behaviour applies. 0 to 300.

on_review_timeout.title: When no reviewer answers in time
on_review_timeout.description: deny (default): refuse the call and tell Claude to wait for the approval. ask: ask the person at the keyboard, who can then override the review for that one call.

content.title: File content sent to Remus
content.description: preview (default): the first 2,000 characters of a write or of each side of an edit, with size and SHA-256. hash: size and SHA-256 only. none: no content at all. Files that look like secrets (.env, keys, credentials) are never sent as text. Also applies to MCP tool inputs.

on_error.title: When Remus cannot decide
on_error.description: Applies when Remus is unreachable, the key is missing or rejected, or the allowance is used up. deny (default): refuse the call. ask: ask the person at the keyboard. pass: let Claude Code decide as if the plugin were not installed.

tools.title: Tools to check
tools.description: Comma-separated tool names; * is a wildcard. Default: Bash,Write,Edit,MultiEdit,NotebookEdit,WebFetch,mcp__*

skip_tools.title: Tools to leave unchecked
skip_tools.description: Comma-separated tool names to exclude from the list above, for example mcp__ide__*. Empty by default.

record_outcomes.title: Record outcomes in Remus
record_outcomes.description: Claim each allowed call in Remus and report whether it succeeded. Uses a second policy decision per call. Off by default.

timeout_ms.title: Request timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for each answer from Remus. 500 to 30000.
